rachel: Kicking off Avante Health pilot today. They want streaming WebSocket + tool/function calling and structured JSON output. Need a short runbook, pricing estimate for ~10k concurrent SSE connections, and a quick checklist for SOC2/security questionnaire items. Can we coordinate? :wave:

sam: Thanks — quick q: will they use our SDK (JS/Python) or raw WebSocket?

rachel: They prefer our JS SDK for the streaming client, with a server-side proxy for authentication (they're on-prem). Also want function calls to trigger lookups in their EMR.

tariq: Ok. For 10k SSEs we should recommend Dedicated reserved capacity with burst headroom. Rough ballpark: dedicated monthly commit starting ~$18k/mo depending on qps and token mix. I'll prepare a basic price range.

lina: For the function/tool calling part we need to confirm the callback pattern. Are they comfortable with webhook callbacks from the proxy, or do they need direct in-band tool calls?

rachel: They asked for in-band structured tool calls (func JSON) so the model can ask for patient record lookups synchronously. Proxy will mediate auth.

sam: Good. Two integration notes: 1) SDK streaming sample for JS is this snippet — paste in docs: `const stream = client.stream({model: 'open-instruct-stream', session: 'pilot-1'}); stream.on('message', m => handle(m));` 2) For function calls we recommend defining strict JSON Schema and using our typed tool call helper.

rachel: Lina, can you draft the minimal schema for the EMR lookup (patient_id string, scope enum, redaction boolean)? They want to see what we'd require before security signs off.

lina: On it. Also flagging dataflow: since proxy is on-prem, they want to ensure no PHI leaves their VPC. We'll need to document that only tokenized prompts (no raw PHI) reach hosted inference, or propose Private deployment if they insist.

tariq: For the SOC2/security questionnaire: note our usual answers — Dedicated/Private options, KMS integration, audit logs, IP allowlist, and we can provide an SOC2 attestation. I'll attach standard wording.

sec-bot: [automated] Checklist item added: "Pilot: Avante Health — Security questionnaire packet requested" by rachel at 1735556666

sam: Also a quick perf note: with structured tool calls you often need low-latency roundtrips. Recommend colocating proxy near inference region or using Private to avoid extra hop. Mention expected RTT in the runbook.

rachel: Great. I'll assemble a one-pager for the customer and the packet for their security team. Action items: Sam -> SDK snippet + minimal runbook; Lina -> EMR lookup schema + dataflow options; Tariq -> price ranges and SOC2 wording. I'll ping once drafts are ready. :thumbsup:

lina: Draft schema posted in DM, will push to this thread when done.

tariq: Pricing draft uploaded to drive: https://drive.redwood.example/avante-pilot-estimate — please review before I send.

sam: Quick follow: any blockers on auth? They mentioned SAML SSO to their proxy and ephemeral creds. We support short-lived tokens from the proxy — need to add handshake snippet to runbook.

rachel: Yes, include handshake. Example snippet we used with Acme bank should be fine.

sec-bot: [automated] Reminder set for follow-up in 48h by rachel

rachel: Thanks all, will consolidate and send to Avante security today. If anything blocks, drop it here. :coffee:
